title: Occult Noir
video_prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: Authentic 1940s supernatural film noir, live-action 35mm photography, crisp monochrome contrast, fine film grain, and restrained professional acting. In a candlelit private office, a woman in an ivory blouse sits at the left and a man in a charcoal coat sits at the right across a small round table, both framed waist-up and close to the camera. Venetian-blind shadows stripe the dark wood walls while one warm table lamp illuminates their faces and a trace of smoke hangs in the air. The woman lifts her eyes from a brass key and speaks with controlled concern; the man listens, then answers with steady eye contact. A slow subtle push-in holds both faces sharply readable in one continuous two-shot.
overall_soundscape: clear high-pitched adult female voice says "The key was warm when I found it" deep low-pitched adult male voice says "Then someone was here before us"
non_diegetic_music: None.
